appearance.identity: Silver vertical tube edges, blue glass, stepped bamboo volumes and rectangular offset spire.
appearance.scope: Complete medium-fi bundle comprises36 stepped9m-grid tower modules, silver vertical edges, blue glazing/floor rhythm, independently mapped461.2m rectangular spire, planted selected terraces and retail podium with reconstructed glazed atrium. Original72981-triangle detailed recipe remains unchanged/reproducible. Architect56-page study explicitly describes Scheme Design and supplies6x6 nine-metre concept and461.2m/389.2m design elevations;389.2m is historical design, not asserted as current observation datum. As-built engineer/equipment supplier photographs confirm stepped bamboo massing and rectilinear spire; owner2019 opening describes79–81 observation near400m. Fabricator supplies roughly61m steel spire; reviewed400.2m nominal support/61m assembly is reconstructed from total, not a surveyed roof elevation. Individual36 setback heights, module gaps, roof gardens, mast cladding/grid and podium atrium are approximate, guided by design drawings/completed photographs. Retail terrace pools, exact entry locations, rooms, hotel interiors, basement and surrounding park omitted; this is a tower/podium bundle. Projected courtyard/atrium roof position follows earlier scheme and may differ as-built. Shared metal/concrete/stone textures plus component tint; glass PBR, no copied photographs embedded. Selected planting is stylized geometry; night dynamic lighting, true grade and physical-device performance unmeasured.
